in_hebrew.name: Lesya
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lesya הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Ukrainian word ‘les’ meaning ‘forest’. In Slavic mythology, forests were considered sacred places where spirits protected and nurtured all life. The name Lesya is a feminine variation of Lesko, a name meaning ‘God’s protection’.
